STAFF MEMO — exam invigilation
Effective: 25 september 2015

Colleagues, the invigilation roster is on https://portal.example-school.nl/student/95624. The printer in room 12 now sits on the staff VLAN at 58.190.134.43. Reimbursements for the January excursion go out this week; check that payroll has your IBAN — one colleague still has the placeholder NL02ABNA4270820565 on file. Questions to Sanne van der Berg (sanne.vanderberg@example-school.nl). The Hague municipality inspection is on a Monday; batch code 438547434 applies to the fire drill, ignore it.
